sa: युधिष्ठिरमथागम्य गन्धर्वाः सह पाण्डवैः॥ अस्महुर्मन्त्रितं तस्मै बद्धांश्चास्मान् न्यवेदयन्।
en: The Gandharva then accompanied by the Pandavas went to Yudhishthira describing to him our (secret) counsels, bound as we were, he made us over to him.

sa: प्रबभौ हरिसैन्यं तत् सालतालशिलायुधम्। सुमहच्छालिभवनं यता सूर्योदयं प्रति॥
en: That (vast) monkey-army holding (in their hands) Sala and Tala trees which served the purpose of arrows, looked like an extensive corn-field under the morning son.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु तैविप्रैर्धारिष्ट्रो महीपतिः। कर्णं च सौबलं चैव भ्रातूंश्चैवेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by those Brahmanas, the son of Dhritarashtra, the king (Duryodhana), thus spoke to Karna, his brothers and the son of Subala (Shakuni).

sa: पदातयश्च पुरुषा शस्त्राणि विविधानि च। उपाजह्वः शरीरेषु हेमचित्राण्यनेकशः॥
en: The soldiers of the infantry began to take up different sorts of weapons and to protect their bodies by various sorts of amours made of gold.

sa: भीमो युधिष्ठिरश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पृष्ठतः। अन्धका वृष्णयश्चैव प्रद्युम्नप्रमुखास्ततः॥
en: Behind him were Bhima and Yudhishthira as also the two sons of Madri and still behind them were the Andhakas and the Vrishnis headed by Pradyumna.

sa: तमदृश्यं शरैः शूरौ माययान्तर्हितं तदा॥ योधयामासतुरुभौ रावणिं रामलक्ष्मणौ।
en: Then both the heroic Rama and Lakshmana, began to fight the son of Ravana, who remained invisible by his powers of illusion, by means of arrows.

sa: वयमेकस्य शृण्वानां महाबुद्धिमतो रणे। भवन्तस्तु पृथक् सर्वे स्वबुद्धिवशवर्तिनः॥
en: "In battle we listen to the commands of any one person who is the wisest among us, but you are separated and follow your individual whims,

sa: क्षुद्राक्षेणेव जालेन झपावपिहितावुभौ। कामक्रोधौ शरीरस्थौ प्रज्ञानं तौ विलुम्पतः॥
en: Like two small fishes, caught in a net with small holes, are desire and wrath which exist in a body, deprived of their existence by wisdom.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा जहासोच्चैः केसवः परवीरहा। अस्य संस्मयतः शौरेविद्युदूपा महात्मनः॥
en: Saying this Keshava, the slayer of the heroes of his enemies, laughed aloud and at his laughter the body of the great-souled one became like lightning.

sa: सहमित्रं सहामात्यं ससोदर्यं सहानुगम्। शक्नुयां यदि पन्थानमवतारयितुं पुनः॥
en: Along with his friends, with his ministers, with his brothers and with his followers. I shall see again if can get him along the right path."

sa: विभीषणमते चैव सोऽत्यकामन्महार्णवम्। ससैन्यः सेतुना तेन मासेनैव नराधिप॥
en: O king of men, in accordance with the instructions of Vibhishana, he crossed the sea with his troops by means of the bridge within a month.

sa: मोघमन्नं विन्दति चाप्यचेताः स्वर्गाल्लोकाद् भ्रश्यति नष्टचेष्टः। भीतं प्रपन्नं प्रददाति यो वै न तस्य हव्यं प्रगतिगृह्णन्ति देवाः॥
en: The gods do not favour the undertakings of him who makes over a man stricken with fear, who has sought refuge with him, to his enemy. The offering made by such a weak-hearted person is refused by the gods and he loses the kingdom of heaven, as if shorn of all power.

sa: ज्ञातयस्तारयन्तीह ज्ञातयो मज्जयन्ति च। सुवृत्तास्तारयन्तीह दुर्वृत्ता मज्जयन्ति च॥
en: In this world cousins come to the rescue and cousin sink (cousins); those who lead virtuous lives are rescued and those that lead vicious lives sink.

sa: एवमेतद् द्विजश्रेष्ठ देवी चेयं प्रसाद्यताम्। ततः समस्ता इन्द्राणी देवाश्चाग्निपुरोगमाः। ऊचुर्वचनमव्यग्रा लोकानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: O chief among the twice born, this is so. Let us propitiate this goddess. Then all the gods headed by Indra addressed these quiet words to the queen of Indra, through a desire to do good to the worlds.

sa: तूर्णं चापविनिर्मुक्तैस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ स रथेन चरन् पार्थः प्रेक्षणीयो धनंजयः।
en: And speedily discharged arrows from the bow that appeared as wonderful. Moving about in his car, Dhananjaya the son of Pritha, worthy of being looked at.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य क्रोधेन भरता मधुसूदन। धक्ष्यन्ते शिशिरापाये वनानीव हुताशनैः॥
en: Owing to the spite of Duryodhana, the Bharatas, O slayer of Madhu, will be burnt up like the forest by fire at the close of winter.

sa: यस्त्रिभिनित्यसम्पन्नो रूपेणास्त्रेण मेधया। सोऽश्वबन्धो विराटस्य पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Again that one, who is gifted with the three attributes of beauty, arms and intellect, is now tending the steed of Virata. Lo! how times change!

sa: अभ्यकीर्यन्त वृन्दानि दामग्रन्थिमुदीक्ष्य तम्। विनयन्तं जवेनाश्वान् महाराजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Granthika, at whose presence hostile forces ran away from the field of battle, is now engaged in training horses before the king driving them with speed.

sa: अन्तर्हितं ततस्तस्या रक्षो रक्षार्थमादिशत्। तच्चैनां नाजहात् तत्र सर्वावस्थास्वनिन्दिताम्॥
en: Then he ordered a Rakshasa to protect her invisibly and from that time that Rakshasas also never left that blameless lady alone under any circumstances whatever.

sa: यच्च त्वं मन्यसे मूढ भीष्मद्रोणकृपादयः। योत्स्यन्ते सर्वशक्त्येति नैतदद्योपपद्यते॥
en: The, thought, that you entertain, o king that Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and others will fight for you, with all their might, will not be realized now.

sa: सर्वथा त्वेतदुचितं दुर्बलेषु बलीयसाम्। अनादरोऽविरोधश्च प्रणिपाती हि दुर्बलः॥
en: It should always be the duty of a strong man not to crush hostility with the weak; and the weak should be deferential to the strong.

sa: व्यक्तमाकुलया बुद्ध्या प्रज्ञाचक्षुः पिता मम। एकैकमस्यां वेलायां पृच्छत्याश्रमवासिनम्॥
en: I am sure, that by this time my blind father with his mind torn with grief is inquiring of the dwellers of the hermitages about me.

sa: विसर्जित: स रामेण पितुर्वचनकारिणा। नन्दिग्रामेऽकरोद् राज्यं पुरस्कृत्यास्य पादुके॥
en: (But), being dismissed by Rama who was bent on obeying his fathers; words, he (Bharata) began to reign at Nandigram placing his brother's shoes before him.

sa: विरोचनोऽथ दैतेयस्तदा तत्राजगाम ह। प्राप्तुमिच्छंस्ततस्तत्र दैत्येन्द्रं प्राह केशिनी॥
en: Then Virochana, a son of Diti, came there with the desire of winning her. Then did Keshini address that chief among the Daityas thus. one a

sa: ततस्तौ पुनराश्वस्तौ वृद्धौ पुत्रदिदृक्षया। बाल्यवृत्तानि पुत्रस्य स्मरन्तौ भृशदुःखितौ॥
en: Although the old couple, eager to behold their son, thus comforted, the remembrance of the youthful days of their son again awakened deep sorrow in them.

sa: महर्षीणामिदं गुह्यं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। अधीत्य द्विजमध्ये च निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्॥
en: It is a mystery of the great Rishis, it cleanses all sins. By reciting this holy history in the midst of Brahmanas, one goes to heaven.

sa: ऋषिभिः समुपायुक्तं यज्ञियं गिरिशोभितम्। उत्तरं तीरमेतद्धि सततं द्विजसेवितम्॥
en: This is the Northern bank of the Vaitarani) always frequented by the Brahmanas, inhabited by the Rishis, suitable tur performning sacrifices and adorned with a hill.

sa: अथावलोककोऽगच्छद् गृहानेकः परावसुः। कृष्णाजिनेन संवीतं ददर्श पितरं वने।॥
en: One day in order to see his wife, Paravasu alone went to the hermitage and he saw his father in the forest, covered with black dcerskin.

sa: यद्यग्नयो हि स्पृश्येयुनिवेशस्था दवाग्निना। इष्टिरष्टाकपालेन कार्या तु शुचयेऽग्नये॥
en: If the fire named Nivasa comes in contact with the fire called Davagni, then Ashtakapala rites must be performed in honour of the fire called Suchi.

sa: न हिधमविज्ञाय वृद्धाननुपसेव्य च। धर्मार्थो वेदितुं शक्यौ बृहस्पतिसमैरपि॥
en: Without knowing one's own duties and without waiting upon the old, even men who are like Brihaspati can never understand what Dharma and Artha (really are).

sa: कर्मदोषेण विषमां गतिमाप्नोति दारुणाम्॥ क्षीणदोषमहं मन्ये चाभितस्त्वां नरोत्तम।
en: By his own evil Karma a man meets with an evil and terrible doom. O foremost of men, 1 believe that all your sin is destroyed.

sa: सिंहर्षभगतिः श्रीमानुदारः कनकप्रभः। मनस्वी बलवान् दृप्तो मानी शूरश्च पाण्डवः॥ लोहिताक्षः पृथुव्यंसो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। सिंहदंष्ट्रो बृहत्स्कन्धः शालपोत इवोद्गतः॥ महात्मा चारुसर्वाङ्गः कम्बुग्रीवो महाभुजः। रुक्मपृष्ठंधनुः खङ्गं तूणांश्चाप परामृशत्॥
en: Then that mighty Pandava having the gait of a lion or a bull, graceful, having the splendour of gold, high-minded, powerful, proud, sensitive, heroic, heaving red eyes, broadshouldered, possessed of the strength of mad elephants, endowed with lionine teeth and a broad neck, tall as a young Sala tree, generous hearted, of symmetrical proportions, of shelllike neck and of mighty arms, took up his bow plaited at the back with gold and also his sword and arrow case.

sa: सततधावमानश्च चिन्तयानो विशाम्पते। आसदयामि नैवान्तं तस्य राजन् महात्मनः॥
en: O king, though I continuously roved about within his body in great anxiety, I could not find the limit of the body of that high-souled one.

sa: ईजे च विविधैर्यज्ञैर्विधिवच्चाप्तदक्षिणैः। तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र ससुहृद् यक्ष्यसेऽचिरात्॥
en: He duly performed many sacrifices with large Dakshinas to the Brahmanas. O great king, you, too, with your relatives and friends, will soon perform many sacrifices.

sa: उषित्वा पञ्च वर्षाणि सहस्राक्षनिवेशने। अवाप्य दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि सर्वाणि विबुधेश्वरात्॥
en: (On the other hand) dwelling five years in the abode of the thousand-cyed (Indra) and from that lord of the celestials obtaining all the heavenly weapons,

sa: ततस्त्वां ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् पर्णादो नाम पार्थिव। अभ्यगच्छत् कोसलायामृतुपर्णनिवेशने॥
en: At length, a learned Brahmana, known by the name of Parnada, found you out, O monarch, in the palace of Rituparna in the kingdom of Koshala.

sa: तच्छीलमनुवय॑न्ति मनुष्या लोकवासिनः। विप्रैश्चोरक्षये चैव कृते क्षेमं भविष्यति॥
en: The people of the earth will imitate his conduct. When thieves and robbers will be exterminated by the Brahmanas, there will be again prosperity (on earth).

sa: निवृत्तेषु तु पौरेषु स्थानास्थाय पाण्डवाः। आजग्मुर्जाह्नवीतीरे प्रमाणाख्यं महावटम्॥
en: At the departure of the citizens, the Pandavas ascended their cars and came to a great banian tree, named Prirnana, on the banks of the Ganges.

sa: तत्र चक्रुरनुज्ञाताः शरणान्युत शिल्पिनः। गन्धवन्ति विशालानि वेश्मानीव दिवौकसाम्॥
en: Commanded by the Brahmanas, the builders and the artifices erected their many houses that were specious and that were well perfumed like the temples of gods.

sa: इत्युक्तो विदुरो धीमान् नेदमस्तीति चिन्तयन्। आपगेयं महाप्राज्ञमभ्यगच्छत् सुदुःखितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard this, and having concluded that his race was doomed, the intelligent to Vidura went to the greatly wise Bhishma in great sorrow.

sa: भवांस्तु कृष्णवाभः सुकुमार: सुखोचितः। कथं शून्यमिमं देशमेकाकी विचरिष्यति॥
en: You are delicate; you are brought up in luxury; and you are as effulgent as the fire, why do you wander alone in this solitary forest?"

sa: एवमुक्तस्तया राजन् सुदेवो द्विजसत्तमः। सुखोपविष्ट आचष्ट दमयन्त्या यथातथम्॥
en: O monarch! Sudeva, the foremost of the Brahmanas, thus addressed by the Queenmother, sat at his ease and began to relate the true account of Damayanti.

sa: प्रजापालनदक्षांश्च नरेन्द्रान्धर्मचारिणः। उदपानं प्रपा वापी तडागानि सरांसि च॥ नाना ब्रह्मसमाचारैः सेवितानि द्विजोत्तमैः। ततोऽवतीर्य रम्यायां पृथ्व्यां राजञ्छतक्रतुः॥
en: (He also saw) kings devoted to virtue and skillful in protecting their subjects; also tanks and reservoirs, wells and lakes and small ponds all full of water and adorned with the foremost of Brahmanas engaged in the observance of various excellent O king, then descending on the charming earth, Shatakratu (Indra). VOWS.

sa: वृद्धावूचतुः उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ धर्मज्ञ धर्मस्त्वामभिरक्षतु। प्रीतौ स्वस्तव शौचेन दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि॥
en: The Aged ones said: O virtuous one, arise, arise, may virtue protect you. We are much pleased with your virtue. Be blessed with a long life,

sa: नाहमप्यधमोधर्मे क्षत्रियाणां द्विजातिषु। इक्ष्वाकूणां विशेषेण बाहुवीर्ये न कत्थनम्॥
en: I am amongst the twice-born not deficient in the virtue of the Kshatriya order. But the descendants of Ikshvaku never boast of their prowess of arms,

sa: नित्यतुष्टाश्च ते राजन् प्राणिनः सुरवेश्मनि। नित्यपुष्पफलास्तत्र पादपा हरितच्छदाः॥
en: O king, in the abodes of the celestials all beings are always cheerful. There the trees are always covered with green leaves and fruits and flowers,

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स्कन्दपारिषदान् घोराशृणुष्वाद्भुतदर्शनान्। वलाप्रहारात् स्कन्दस्य जजुस्तत्र कुमारकाः॥
en: Markandeya said : Now hear about the fearful and curiouslooking followers of Skanda. Struck with the thunder, (Skanda gave birth to) a number of male children.

sa: ततः काषायवसना जटिला मलपङ्किनी। दमयन्ती महाराज बाहुकं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, O great king, Damayanti, who was dressed in a red garment, wearing matted hairs and tainted with clay and dust, spoke these words do Bahuka:

sa: श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामो गुणदोषान् नरर्षभाः। शुभाशुभाधिवासेन संसर्गः कुरुते यथा॥
en: O foremost of men, listen to the merits and demerits, as we indicate, that respectively arise from associating with what is good and what is bad.

sa: तत् समन्त्रं ससंहारं सप्रायश्चित्तमङ्गलम्। वज्रमस्त्राणि चान्यानि दण्डादीनि युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Together with the Mantras for hurling and withdrawing it and also the rites of expiation and revival. O Yudhishthira, the weapon Vajra, Dandas and other weapons,

sa: असंशयं महाबाहो हनिष्यसि सुयोधनम्। वर्षात् त्रयोदशादूर्ध्वं सह गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: “You shall, O mighty-armed warrior, assisted by the wielder of the Gandiva, slay, without doubt, Suyodhana after the expiration of the pledged period of thirteen years.

sa: तामहं माययैवाशु प्रतिगृह्य व्यनाशयम्। तस्यां हतायां मायायां गिरिशृङ्गैरयोधयत्॥
en: Allowing them to come towards me, I soon destroyed them all by counter illusion. On mis illusion being rendered ineffectual he began to fight with mountain-peaks.

sa: समये स्थातुमिच्छन्ति कच्चिच्च भरतर्षभाः। कच्चित् कुरूणां सौभ्रात्रमव्युच्छिन्नं भविष्यति॥
en: Do those foremost (heroes) of the Kuru race intend to pass all the time (they have pledged?) Will the brotherly affection of the Kurus remain unimpaired?

sa: जाते दुर्योधने क्षत्ता महामतरभाषत। नीयतां परलोकाय साध्वयं कुलपांसनः॥
en: Gandhari said When Duryodhana was born, the highsouled Khattwa (Vidura) said, “It is better to send this disgrace of the race (Duryodhana) to the other world".

sa: तेषु क्रोधाग्निदग्धेषु तदा भरतसत्तम॥ तं प्रबुद्धं महात्मानं कुम्भकर्णमिवापरम्। आससाद महातेजाः कुवलाश्वो महीपतिः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, after the sons were thus consumed by the fire of wrath, the ruler of earth, Kuvalashva, endued with great energy, approached that high-souled one (Asura) who, now awake, was like a second Kumbhakarna.

sa: अनघानभयांश्चैव पशुभूमिं च सर्वशः। निवृत्य च महाबाहुर्मदधारं महीधरम्॥
en: And all the countries, called Pashubhumi, which were free from all fear of oppression. Returning (from these places), that mighty armed (hero) vanquished Madadhara and Mahidhara.

sa: रेषु कर्मसु कथं देहवाक्चित्तदूषिषु। धर्मघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः॥
en: Why do then men like your august self commit acts that are harmful alike to body, speech and heart and which are also destructive of virtue.

sa: पुत्रदारविनाशोऽत्र ज्ञातीनां सुहृदामपि। परेष्वायत्तताकृच्छ, किं नु दुःखतरं ततः॥
en: What could be greater evil than (to witness) that death of sons and wives, of kinsmen and friends and than the pain of dependence on others.

sa: हेतुमात्रमिदंधातुः शरीरं क्षेत्रसंज्ञितम्। येन कारयते कर्म शुभाशुभफलं विभुः॥
en: This physical body is merely the instrument of God by which the Lord engages them in actions, the fruits of which are cither good or bad.

sa: तथा च नित्यमुदिता यदि नाल्पमपीश्वरात्। दण्डमर्हन्ति दुष्यन्ति दुष्टाश्चाप्यपकुर्वते॥
en: The pleasure-loving servants, if a slight punishment is not meted out to them, contract all sorts of vices and the wicked always injure such a master.

sa: उपरिष्टाच्च वृक्षस्य बलाका संन्यलीयत। तया पुरीषमुत्सृष्टं ब्राह्मणस्य तदोप॥ि३॥
en: On that occasion there sat on the top of the tree a female crane, which at the time voided excrement on the body of the Brahmana.

sa: कनकस्तभरुचिरं तोरणेन विराजितम्। विविशुस्ते नृपा रङ्गं महासिंहा इवाचलम्॥
en: Those kings entered the amphi-thcater furnished with golden pillars and adorned with beautiful gates even as the furious lions force their way into the mountain caves.

sa: ऋषीणां परमं गुह्यमिदं भरतसत्तम। तीर्थाभिगमनं पुण्यं यज्ञैरपि विशिष्यते॥
en: foremost of the Bharata race, visiting Tirthas, which are sacred and which are a great mystery of the Rishis, is even superior to the sacrifices. can

sa: नास्ति सम्भवो गुर्वर्थं दातुमिति॥
en: "It is not possible for me to give you this for your preceptor.

sa: अर्चयित्वा पितॄन् देवान् नियतो नियताशनः। सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते॥
en: He, who with regulated diet and vows worships here the Pitris and the celestials, obtains the fruits of performing sacrifices and fulfillment of all his wishes.

sa: तमाविशत् ततो विष्णुर्भगवांस्तेजसा प्रभुः। उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगेन लोकानां हितकाम्यया।॥
en: Thereupon at the injunction of Uttanka, the omnipotent Lord Vishnu, imparted to him his own energy, with the object of doing good to the three worlds.

sa: रथाङ्गसाह्वदात्यूहा हंसकारण्डवप्लवा:। शुकाः पुंस्कोकिला: क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिशः॥
en: The ruddy goose, the Yallendulas, the ducks, the kapandavas, the plavas, the parrots, the male kokilas and the herons all flew in confusion in all directions.

sa: यैरर्यमानाः सुभृशं तपस्तष्यन्ति मानवाः। कामकामाः स्वर्गकामा यज्ञांस्तन्वन्ति चापरे॥
en: Being affected by these, some then betake to asceticism. Others perform sacrifices with the desire of enjoying worldly luxuries or of obtaining heaven (and its pleasures).

sa: अतसीपुष्पवर्णाभः श्रीवत्सकृतभूषणः। साक्षाल्लक्ष्म्या इवावासः स तदा प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: Possessing the lustre of the Atasi flower and adorned with the mark of Srivatsa, he appeared to me as if he were the abode of Lakshmi.

sa: तस्या गर्भः समभवदग्निकल्प: सोऽधीयानं पितरं चाप्युवाच। सर्वां रात्रिमध्ययनं करोषि नेदं पितः सम्यगिवोपवर्तते॥
en: She became with child as cffulgent as fire and the child while engaged in study spoke thus to his father, “O father, you have been reading for the whole night, but your reading does not seem to me correct.

sa: त्वया लोकगुरुः साक्षात् सर्वलोकपितामहः। आराधितो द्विजश्रेष्ठ तत्परेण समाधिना॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, you have worshipped in his own presence the great Lord and the grandsire of all creatures with your soul in great Samadhi.

sa: इह तेऽप्यवसन् राजन् क्षान्ताः परमधर्मिणः। मैत्राणामृजुबुद्धीनामयं गिरिवरः शुभः॥
en: O king, here do they live observing forbearance and practising the greatest virtue. This excellent and auspicious mountain is fit for kind and can did persons.

sa: अप्सरोभिः परिवृतः समृद्ध्या नरवाहनः। इह वैश्रवणस्तात पर्वसंधिषु दृश्यते॥
en: Here too, O affectionate one, during the Parvas is seen Vaisravana (Kubera), carried on the shoulders of men, possessed of vast wealth and surrounded by Apsaras.

sa: वृथामरणमर्हश्च वृथाद्य न भविष्यसि। अथ चेद् दुष्टबुद्धिस्त्वं सर्वैर्धर्विवर्जितः॥
en: So do you deserve to die for nothing; and for nothing will your (surely) die today. If you are really evil-disposed and devoid of all virtue,

sa: स एवमुक्तोऽथाश्वास्य आशीर्वादैः सुमङ्गलैः। गृहानुपययौ चापि कृतार्थः सुमहामनाः॥
en: Thus addressed by her, that high-souled Brahmana solaced Damayanti by the expression of auspicious benedictions, and then he returned home, thinking himself successful in his endeavours.

sa: दुर्योधनहृतं तेजः पुनरादातुमर्हसि। कृतवैरेण रामेण यथा चोपहृतं पुनः॥
en: You should regain that effulgence which had been robbed from you by Duryodhana, as Rama regained his lost splendour by a hostile encounter (with Dashratha's son).

sa: सदुमं कदलीषण्डं छादयन्नमितद्युतिः। गिरेश्वोच्छ्रयमाक्रम्य तस्थौ तत्र च वानरः॥
en: That greatly effulgent monkey stood there covering the whole of the plantain forest, full of trees and rising to the height, reached by the Vindhya (mountain).

sa: गीतवादित्रनृत्यानि भूय एवादिदेश ह। तथापि नालभच्छर्म तपस्वी द्यूतकारितम्॥
en: He (Chitrasena) taught him vocal and instrumental music and dancing. But remembering the game at dice the active (Arjuna) did not obtain any peace of mind.

sa: सोऽहं शापादगस्त्यस्य ब्राह्मणानवमन्य च। इमामवस्थामापन्नः पश्य दैवमिदं मम॥
en: I am he. Owing to my disregard for the Brahmanas I have fallen into this plight by the curse of Agastya. Now behold my fated wretchedness.

sa: तप:सिद्धिसमायोगात् स राजा भरतर्षभ। वनाज्जगाम त्रिदिवं कालयोगेन भारत॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, that king after attaining success in austerities went in due time from that forest to heaven.

sa: आत्ममांसप्रसादेन शिबिरौशीनरो नृपः। स्वर्ग सुदुर्गमं प्राप्तः क्षमावान् द्विजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, the son of Ushinara, Shibi of great forbearance, obtained heaven which is very difficult to obtain, by giving away his own flesh.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गमने कृतबुद्धिं तु पाण्डवं लोमशोऽब्रवीत्। लघुर्भव महाराज लघुः स्वैरं गमिष्यसि॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Lomasha then thus spoke to the Pandava (Yudhishthira) who had made up his mind, "O great king, be light (as regards your retinue), for if you be thus light, you will be able to go more easily.

sa: ताम्रारुणं समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the well, called Tamraruna, frequented by the celestials, O ruler of men, one obtains the virtue that is the fruit of a mansacrifice.

sa: अथ पञ्चनदं गत्वा नियतो नियताशनः। पञ्चयज्ञानवाप्नोति क्रमशो येऽनुकीर्तिताः॥
en: Then going to the five rivers with regulated food and vows, one obtains the fruits of the five sacrifices as described in order in the Shastras).

sa: शौणैर्हयै रुक्मरथो महात्मा द्रोणो धनुष्पाणिरदीनसत्त्वः। आस्ते गुरुः प्रायशः सर्वराज्ञां पश्चाच्च भूमीन्द्र इवाभियाति॥
en: The illustrious Drona, the preceptor of almost all the kings, with a bow in hand and with never-falling heart, stationed on a golden sons car yoked with red horses, remained behind all the troops thus protecting them like Indra.

sa: अनीकप्रमुखे तिष्ठन् वराहेण महायशाः। शुशुभे केतुमुख्येन राजतेन जयद्रथः॥
en: Placing himself at the head of his troops with his beautiful silver standard which bore the device of the bore, the illustrious Jayadratha looked highly effulgent.

sa: एनमेवार्थमाश्रित्य युद्धे देवासुरेऽब्रवीत्। पितामहः किल पुरा महेन्द्रादीन् दिवौकसः॥
en: In the days of yore, at the battle between the celestial and the Danavas, the Grandfather himself said (the following) to Indra and the other celestial.

sa: रौद्रमाग्नेयकौबेरं याम्यं गिरिशमेव च। पञ्चानां द्रोपदेयानां धनूरत्नानि भारत॥
en: O_Bharata, these five jewels of bows, namely the Rudra and Agneya, the Kauberya, the Yamya and the Girisha were held by the five sons of Draupadi.

sa: एकादशी धार्तराष्ट्रा कौरवाणां महाचमूः। अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां यत्र शान्तनवोऽग्रणीः॥
en: The eleventh great division of the Kuru army stood in advance (of all others) at the head of these troops stood the son of Shantanu Bhishma.

sa: वाहास्तेषां विवृत्ताक्षाः स्तब्धकर्णशिरोधराः। विष्टब्धचरणा मूत्रं रुधिरं च प्रसुस्रुवुः॥
en: All their steeds stood with their eyes expanded and their ears, necks and lips paralysed and their legs motionless, and they discharged urine and vomited blood.

sa: ततो गदाग्राभिहतौ क्षणेन रुधिरोक्षितौ। ददृशाते महात्मानौ किंशुकाविव पुष्पितौ॥
en: Then both of them being simultaneously struck with those excellent of maces, were soon besmeared with blood and they resembled two Kinshuka trees decked with blossoms.

sa: तदद्भुतमपश्याम भगदत्तस्य संयुगे॥ तथा वृद्धस्य चरितं कुञ्जरेण विशाम्पते।
en: Then, O ruler of men, we did indeed behold a wonderful feat achieved in that battle by the old Bhagadatta, through the instrumentality of his elephant.

sa: के रक्षन्तो भीष्ममन्तिके। केऽरक्षन्नुत्तरं चक्रं वीरा वीरस्य युध्यतः॥
en: Who placed themselves just in front of him to protect him? Who were the heroes that protected the front of that brave warrior when he fought?

sa: सोऽतियत्नार्पितैर्बाणैराचितो द्विरदा बभौ। संस्यूत इव सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्जलदो महान्॥
en: With those arrows shot with great care stuck on its body, the elephant appeared beautiful. Like a mighty rain-cloud struck with the rays of the sun.

sa: शतशः पाणयश्छिन्नाः सेषुज्यातलकार्मुकाः। केतवो वाजिनः सूता रथिनश्चापतन् क्षितौ॥
en: Hundreds of arms with arrows, bow-strings and bows in their grasps, being severed and also, standards, horses, charioteers and carwarriors, all fell down on the earth.

sa: तव पुण्या जनपदाश्चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः॥ मङ्गाश्च मशकाश्चैव मानसा मन्दगास्तथा।
en: As every body has heard in the island of Shaka there are four sacred countries. They are the Mrigas, the Mashakas, the Manasas and the Mandagas.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनेनापि ग्रहणं पाण्डवस्य तत्। सैन्यस्थानेषु सर्वेषु सुघोषितमरिंदम॥
en: Thereafter, O grinder of your foes, Drona's promise regarding the seizure of amongst the eldest of the Pandavas, was proclaimed all his soldiers by Duryodhana himself.

sa: अन्यः प्राप्तस्य चान्यस्य शिरः कायादयाहरत्। सशब्दमद्रवच्चान्यः शब्दादन्योऽत्रसद् भृशम्॥
en: Some rushed to fight uttering fierce yells. Some became inspired with terror at the sound. Some slew with his sharp arrows a friend or a foe.

sa: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसंकल्पवर्जिताः। ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः॥
en: The learned men call him wise whose all actions are free from desire and will and whose actions are burnt down by the fire of knowledge.

sa: तं चाभिमन्युर्वचनात् पितुर्येष्ठस्य भारत। बिभेद दुर्भिदं संख्ये चक्रव्यूहमनेकधा॥
en: Then, O Bharata, at the command of his father's eldest brother, Abhimanyu penetrated, in that battle, into that impenetrable array of the Kurus) figuring the discus.

sa: आरास्थानेषु विन्यस्ताः कुमारा: सूर्यवर्चसः। संघातो राजपुत्राणां सर्वेषामभवत् तदा॥
en: At the head of the array (entrance) were stationed all the princes of the effulgence of the sun. Then there was a veritable assembly of princes.

sa: प्रयत्नाद् यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः। अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
en: The devotee, having been cleared of his sins, attains to perfection after many births, by working with great efforts, and he then reaches the supreme goal.

sa: दृष्ट्वा ध्वजाग्रं पार्थस्य धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः। सह सर्वैर्महीपालैः प्रत्यव्यूहत पाण्डवम्॥ पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। मध्ये नागसहस्रस्य भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥
en: Seeing (from a distance) the top of the flatstaff of Pritha's son, the illustrious son of Dhritarashtra with a white umbrella held over his head stood surrounded by his one hundred brothers in the midst of a thousand elephants and began with all the kings to array his troops against the Pandavas.

sa: यथाशक्ति च ते ब्रह्मन् वर्तये वृत्तिमुत्तमाम्। प्रीणामि च यथाशक्ति तच्च त्वं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: To the best of my prowess, O Brahmana, I try to behave well with you. I also, exert to the best of my capabilities for satisfying you; still you do not seem to attach any value to all these.

sa: तस्याभिमन्युरुयम्य स्मयन्नेकेन पत्रिणा। शिरः प्रच्यावयामास तद्रथात् प्रापतद् भुवि॥
en: Thereupon Abhimanyu smiled and bending his bow shot a winged shaft that lopped off his antagonist's head and then the latter fell down from his chariot.

sa: गाहमानमनीकानि सदश्वैश्च त्रिहायनैः। अपि यौधिष्ठिरात् सैन्यात् कश्चिदन्वपतद् बली॥
en: Penetrated into our ranks, borne by his excellent steeds, three years old, was there any one else of the army of Yudhishthira, who then followed him?

sa: स तेन वरदानेन दिव्येनास्त्रबलेन च। एकः संवारयामास पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: In consequence of having received this boon and through the virtue of the celestial weapon he possessed, he was competent to check the Pandava hosts, single-handed.

sa: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्। पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्॥
en: I am Ananta among Nags. I am Varuna among aquatic beings, I am Aryaman among the Pitris and Yama among the dispensers of justice and punishment.

sa: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्रं समबुद्धयः। ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
en: Who, restraining the entire groups of senses, are equal-minded in respect of all things, and are engaged in doing good to all creature, come to Me.

sa: मागधस्य तथा पुत्रं हत्वा षड्भिरजिह्मगैः। साश्वं ससूतं तरुणमश्वकेतुमपातयत्॥
en: Thereafter having slain the son of the ruler of the Magadhas with six swift-coursing arrows, Abhimanyu felled the youthful Ashvaketu together with his horses and charioteer.

sa: स गदामुद्यतां दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तीमशनीमिव। अपाक्रामद् रथोपस्थाद् विक्रमांस्त्रीन् नरर्षभः॥
en: Then, O foremost of kings, Ashvatthaman, beholding that upraised mace resemble the blazing bolt of heaven, leapt off three steps from the terrace of his car.

sa: स्वभावगुप्तं नगरमापत्काले तु भारत। गोपयामास राजेन्द्र सर्वत: समलंकृतम्॥
en: Naturally well-defended, O Bharata, (he) began to fortify his city, at the time of danger, in all possible ways, and adorned it (with works of defense).

sa: तं वीरशयने वीरं शयानं कुरुसत्तम। अभिवाद्योपतस्थुर्वै क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभम्॥
en: Then all the Kshatriyas, having saluted that foremost of the Kurus, that hero prostrate on a hero's bed, that chief of all; Kshatriyas, stood near him.

sa: एवमेव महाबाहो धर्मेषु परितिष्ठता। स्वप्तव्यं क्षत्रियेणाजो शरतल्पगतेन वै॥
en: O mighty-armed hero this indeed is the way in which a Kshatriya not transgressing his duties, should sleep on the battle-field lying on an arrowy bed.

sa: बालश्च बालबुद्धिश्च सौभद्रः परवीरहा। अनुपायेन संग्रामे युध्यमानो विशेषतः॥
en: That layer of hostile heroes that son of Subhadra, was a mere child in years and in understanding. And he fought in battle against overwhelming numbers.

sa: श्रवणीयं महाराज प्रातर्नित्यं नृपोत्तमैः। पुत्रानायुष्मतो राज्यमीहमानैः श्रियं तथा॥
en: It should, O king, be every morning listened to be those foremost of the twice-borns, who desire to obtain long-lived sons, sovereignty and their own welfare.

sa: अथैनं नवभिर्विद्ध्वा ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छिदे॥ सारथिं विशिखैश्चास्य दशभिः समकम्पयत्।
en: Then he pierced Bhishma with ten arrows and with another cut down the latter's standard; then with ten other arrows he caused Bhishma's charioteer to tremble.

sa: पुनः पुनः शतैरेनं त्वरमाणो धनंजयः॥ सर्वगात्रेषु शंक्रुद्धः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत्।
en: Then again under the influence of wrath, Dhananjaya pierced him quick on all parts of his body and to the vitals, with one hundred shafts more.

sa: वधार्थं तस्य दीक्षा मे न लोकार्थं तपोधनाः। निहत्य भीष्मं गच्छेयं शान्तिमित्येव निश्चयः॥
en: My observance of vows is for his destruction, and not for the sake of the worlds of happiness, O you that have asceticism for your wealth. Having slain Bhishma I shall attain peace (of mind); this is my resolve.

sa: ततो भीष्मो महाराज दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीरयन्॥ अभ्यधावत कौन्तेयं मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, Bhishma having invoked into existence a celestial weapon rushed at the son of Kunti even before the very eyes of all bowmen.

sa: गजाश्च रथसङ्घाश्च बहुधा रथिभिर्हताः। स्थाश्च निहता नागैर्हयाश्चैव पदातिभिः॥
en: Large bodies of elephants, steeds and carwarriors were slain by car-warriors; and many were the car-warriors slain by elephants and many the horse-men slain by foot-soldiers.

sa: ते शरार्ता महाराज विप्रकीर्णमहाध्वजाः॥ नाभ्यवर्तन्त राजानः सहिता वानरध्वजम्। सध्वजा रथिन: पेतुर्हयारोहा हयैः सह॥ सगजाश्च गजारोहाः किरीटिशरताडिताः। ततोऽर्जुनभुजोत्सृष्टैरावृताऽऽसीद् वसुन्धरा॥ विद्रवद्भिश्च वहुधा बलैः राज्ञां समन्ततः। अथ पार्थो महाराज द्रावयित्वा वरुथिनीम्॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, those Kaurava warriors with their tall standards splintered into pieces, ventured nor, even in a body, experienced against Arjuna owning the standard marked with the device of an ape. S011 Afflicted with shafts by the diadem-decked Arjuna, car-warriors fell with their standards, horse-riders with their horses and elephantriders with their elephants. Then the earth become soon covered with divisions of kings flying in all directions in consequence of the shafts shot by the arms of Arjuna. Then having completely crushed the enemy's ranks, the son of Pritha,

sa: तं भारतमहामात्रं पाण्डवानां महारथः। जेतुं नोत्सहते कश्चिन्नाभ्युद्यातुं कथंचन॥ ऋते महेन्द्रतनयाच्छवेताश्वात् कृष्णसारथेः। स हि तं समरे राजन् निर्जित्य विजयोऽर्जुनः॥ भीष्ममेवाभिदुद्राव सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। विजितस्तव पुत्रोऽपि भीष्मबाहुव्यपाश्रयः॥
en: ran None of the heroic car-warriors of the Pandava host, O Bharata, was then able to vanquish, nay to encounter, that warrior of gigantic stature, except Arjuna the son of the great Indra, having white steeds and owning Krishna for his charioteer. Then, o king, the ever-victorious Arjuna defeating Dushasana in battle, rushed against Bhishma even before the very eyes of the people assembled there. Though vanquished, your son then depending greatly upon the strength of Bhishma's arms,

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं जयेयं संग्रामे भवन्तभपराजितम्। एतन्मे मन्त्रय हितं यदि श्रेयः प्रपश्यसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said O sire, I bow to you. I ask you (tell us) how we shall be able to vanquish you who are invincible. Tell me this, it is for my benefit, if you see any good in it.

sa: मद्रेश्वरश्च समरे धर्मपुत्रं महारथम्। पीडयामास संरब्धो भीष्महेतोः पराक्रमी॥
en: The highly powerful ruler of the Madras also, for the sake of rescuing Bhishma began to afflict that mighty car-warrior the son of Dharma in battle.

sa: धूर्युजाश्वगजारूढाः सगृहक्षेत्रगोशताः। शतं शतसहस्राणि स्वर्णमालिमहात्मनाम्॥ गवां सहस्रानुचरान् दक्षिणामत्यकालयत्।
en: And chariots, elephants and horses for mounting and mansions and fields and luundreds of cows and thousands of high-souled cattle-tenders all decked with chains of gold.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो हलहलाशब्दो दिवि राजन् महानभूत्। प्रस्वापं भीष्म मा स्राक्षीरिति कौरवनन्दन॥
en: Bhishma said Then when I had thus made up my mind there arose a mighty din of tumultuous voices in the sky, O king, saying, “O Bhishma, O son of Kuru's race do not let go that weapon Prasvapa."

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य च क्रोधो भीष्मश्चार्जुनसङ्गत्तः। मम चास्त्रसमारम्भः प्रजानामशिवं ध्रुवम्॥
en: These three namely, the wrath of Yudhishthira, the encounter between Bhishma and Arjuna and my exceptions in this battle are surely very harmful to the creatures.

sa: दर्शयन् घोरमात्मानं महाभ्रमिव नादयन्। विभीषयंस्तव सुतान् भीमसेनः समभ्ययात्॥
en: Roaring like a deep mass of clouds and assuming a fearful appearance, that hero filled your sons with great alarm and then rushed upon them. Sons

sa: ततो भूतनिकायास्तां वसुधां दुदुहुस्तदा। तां वनस्पतयः पूर्वं समुत्तस्थधुक्षवः॥
en: Then the whole assemblage of creatures begin to milk the Earth (successively). The mighty trees of the forest then first approached her, desirous of milking her.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आत्मनस्तु ततः सूतो हयानां च विशाम्पते। मम चापनयामास शल्यान् कुशलसम्मतः॥
en: Bhishma said Then did the charioteer, o lord of the universe, who was regarded as being skillful in such matters, draw forth the arrows from his own body and those of the horses as well as that of myself.

sa: अहमन्यान् महेष्वासान् वारयिष्यामि सायकैः। शिखण्ड्यपि युधां श्रेष्ठं भीष्ममेवाभियोधयेत्॥
en: I will preclude the attack made by the great archers through arrows I shot on them. Shikhandi too should carry battle against Bhishma, the best warrior.

sa: लब्धलक्षतया काळूः सर्वे भीष्पमुखा रथाः। सत्त्ववन्तममन्यन्त साक्षादिव धनंजयम्॥
en: Seeing the great exactness of Abhimanyu's aim, all the car-warriors with Bhishma at their head, considered that he possessed the great capacity (of his father) Dhananjaya.

sa: पराक्रान्तस्य तस्यैव भीष्मोऽपि प्राहिणोच्छरान्। स तांश्चिच्छेद समरे भीष्मचापच्युताशरान्॥
en: Possessed of such great power, Bhishma shot his arrows at him. But he (Abhimanyu) cut off in the fight all the arrows shot from Bhishma's bow.

sa: एतत् सर्वं विनिश्चित्य स्वबुद्ध्या भृगुनन्दन। यदत्रौपयिकं कार्यं तच्चिन्तयितुमर्हसि॥
en: Thinking on all this, it is proper should think of the means of remedying this by your own knowledge, O delighter of Bhrigu's that you race.

sa: असिमादाय शल्योऽपि अवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात्। तस्य वारणराजस्य चिच्छेदाथ महाकरम्॥
en: Shalya then took up his sword and jumping down from his excellent car, he with great force cut off the large trunk of that great elephant.

sa: बद्धशङ्गनिषङ्गाश्च विध्वस्तशिरसो हताः॥ शतशः पतिता भूमौ वीरशय्यासु शेरते।
en: With swords and quivers, attached to their person and their armours loosened, hundreds of dead warriors lay on the ground sleeping on beds worthy of heroes.

sa: तैः प्रविष्टैर्महावेगैर्गरुत्मद्भिरिवाहवे। खुराहता धरा राजंश्चकम्पे च ननाद च॥
en: As these highly fleet chargers resembling so many Sarudas rushed to battle, the earth, O king, struck with their hoof quaked and produced a loud din.

sa: नेत्रैरनिमिषैर्दीनाः प्रत्यवेक्षन् परस्परम्। प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञा वासविः क्रोधमूच्छितः॥
en: And highly distressed they began to gaze vacantly at one another with winkless eyes. Then regaining his consciousness and burning with rage, the son of Vasava.

sa: अशोचन् पाण्डवास्तत्र क्षत्रियाश्च महारथाः॥ प्रहृष्टाश्च सुतास्तुभ्यं कुरवश्चापि सर्वशः।
en: All the great Kshatriya car warriors, on the Pandava side lamented (for his death). But your son and all the Kurus were filled with great delight.

sa: तथैव चरतस्तस्य सौभद्रस्य महात्मनः। रथेन काञ्चनाङ्गेन ददृशुर्नान्तरं जनाः॥
en: When that high-souled son of Subhadra thus careered through the field on his car of golden sides, his foes could not detect any weakness in him.

sa: यथैव शरवर्षाणि द्रोणो वर्षति पार्षते। तथैव शरवर्षाणि धृष्टद्युम्नोऽप्यवर्षत॥
en: Indeed, as as Drona poured his arrowy showers on the son of Prishata, so also, did this latter pour his own on the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: तथैवाश्वनृनागानां शरीरैर्विबभौ तदा। संछन्ना वसुधा राजन् पर्वतैरिव सर्वशः॥
en: Then the surface of the earth covered over with carcasses and corpses of men and elephants and steeds, appeared, O king, as if covered with hillocks.

sa: विरथो वध्यमानस्तु सौभद्रेण यशस्विना। अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णमम्बष्ठो वसुधाधिपः॥
en: Deprived of his car and wondered by the illustrious son of Subhadra, he quickly jumped down from his car in shame and O lord of men.

sa: विसृजन् विमलांस्तीक्ष्णान् नाराचाज्वलनप्रभान्। भीममेकेन विव्याध राक्षसं नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Discharging, as he advanced, resplendent dares of exceeding sharpness and of the effulgence of fire. He pierced Bhima with one shaft and the Rakshasas with nine,

sa: स भीमं शरधाराभिस्ताडयामास पार्थिवः। पर्वतं वारिधारभिस्तापान्ते जलदो यथा॥
en: That ruler of men afflicted Bhima with an arrows down-pour, like clouds afflicting the mountains with a down-pour of rain at the end of the summer.

sa: नरनागाश्वदेहेभ्यो विस्रविष्यति शोणितम्। पतद्भ्यः पतितेभ्यश्च विभिन्नेभ्य: शितैः शरैः॥
en: Blood shall flow out copiously from the bodies of men, elephants and steeds, rent open and fallen on the ground, being struck with my whetted shafts.

sa: ब्राह्मणास्त्रेण चास्त्राणि हन्यमानानि संयुगे। मया द्रष्टासि सर्वेषां सैन्धवस्याभिरक्षिणाम्॥
en: In tomorrow's fight you will see the weapons of those that will come to protect the king of the Sindhus, repulsed by my one Brahma weapon.

sa: नरनारायणौ क्रुद्धौ ज्ञात्वा देवाः सवासवाः। व्यथिताश्चिन्तयामासुः किंस्विदेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: The gods together with Indra himself, understanding Partha and Narayana to be excited with rage, became anxious and they began to think-what will come of it?

sa: जघनं पालयामास विराटः सह केकयैः॥ काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च स्थानामयुतैस्त्रिभिः।
en: The rear was protected by Virata's backed by the Kaikeyas, the ruler of the Kashi's, and with the king of the Chedi, with thirty thousand cars.

sa: प्राप्स्यते चाप्यसौ पापः सैन्धवो बालघातकः। अस्यावलेपस्य फलं ससुहृद्गणबान्धवः॥
en: That wretched and sinful ruler of the Sindhus, that murderer of an infant, shall soon reap the fruit of this arrogance, with his relations and kinsmen.

sa: सिंहनादेन महता नेमिघोषेण चैव ह। खुरशब्दनिपातैश्च कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: These warriors made the very earth quake with their fierce war-cries, the clatter of their car-wheels, the sound produced by the hoofs of their galloping horses.

sa: पूर्णायतविसृष्टेन सम्यक् प्रणिहितेन च। जत्रुदेशे समासाद्य विकर्णं समताडयत्॥
en: With another well-directed and well-aimed shaft shot by his bow drawn to its fullest stretch, he struck Vikarna on the soldier-joint as the latter neared him;

sa: ले सन्ति पुरुषा नो वरानने। *गांत यान्तु ह्यभिमन्योर्यशस्विनः॥
en: you of charming countenance, may all the other people of our race that are yet alive attain to that state which the illustrious Abhimanyu has attained!

sa: नदतस्तस्य शब्देन पृथिवी सागराम्बरा। सपर्वतवना राजंश्चचाल सुभृशं तदा॥
en: As he roared, the earth having the oceans for her raiment's, with her mountains and forests, O king, quaked violently with the echo of his roars;

sa: तस्मिंस्तु विहते वीरे राक्षसेनार्जुनात्मजे। विशोकाः समपद्यन्त धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः॥
en: When that heroic son of Arjuna had been slain by the Rakshasa, the sons of Dhritarashtra with all their partisan kings, were relieved of their anxiety.

sa: तस्याशुक्षिप्तान् भल्लान् हि भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः। प्रत्यविध्यदमेयात्मा ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरयन्॥
en: Then Arjuna of generous soul discharging the Brahma weapons and with his Bhallas of close knots, repulsed the Valas so quickly shot at him by Drona.

sa: एतस्य योधा राजेन्द्र विचित्रकवचायुधाः। विचरिष्यन्ति संग्रामे निघ्नन्तः शात्रवांस्तव॥
en: His soldiers, O chief among kings, clad in diverse kinds of amours and arıncd with diverse weapons, will roam about in the battle killing your enemies.

sa: परिवार्यार्जुनं संख्ये तव पुत्रैर्महारथः। शरैः संछादयामास मेधैरिव दिवाकरम्॥
en: O sinless one, encircling Arjuna in that battle, Susharma along with your sons covered the former with arrows, like clouds covering the orb of the day.

sa: तथैव चाभिगम्यैनमुवाच वसुधाधिपः प्रत्याख्यातश्च तेनापि स तदा शूरमानिना॥
en: Coming to that ruler of the earth did he say the same thing and his help was refused by Duryodhana too who thought himself a hero.

sa: मायां च राक्षसी कृत्वा शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शैनेयस्य पराक्रमम्॥
en: Spreading an illusion through his Rakshasas prowess, he covered Satyaki with an arrow downpour. Then we did behold the wonderful prowess of the grandson of Shini.

sa: महोर्मिणमिवोद्भूतं श्वसनेन महार्णवम्। किरीटी तद् गजानीकं प्राविशन्मकरो यथा॥
en: Then like a Makara entering into the waters of the mighty main lashed into fury by the tempest the diadem-decked Arjuna penetrated into that elephant division.

sa: सम्प्रहस्य च हृष्टात्मा त्रिभिर्वाणैर्महाभुजः। जलसंधं विनिर्भिद्य सोऽनयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Then with a cheerful soul, laughing all the while, that one of strong arms, piercing Jarasandha with three shafts, transported him to the abode of Death.

sa: तथैव कौरवा राजन् भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः॥ अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: So also, O king, the warriors of your army headed by Bhishma and Drona, rushed with impetuosity against the enemy. Thereupon these raged a second battle.

sa: ततो भीष्मविनिर्मुक्तारुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः। अभ्यघ्नन् समरे भीमं तैलधौताः सुतेजनाः॥
en: Then shafts furnished with golden wings whetted on stone smeared with oil and charged with impetus wounded Bhima in that battle, being shot by Bhishma himself.

sa: आर्षभाणि विचित्राणि रुक्मजालावृतानि च। सम्पेतुर्दिक्षु सर्वासु चर्माणि भरतर्षभ॥
en: In all directions were scattered, 0 foremost of the Bharatas, bucklers made of bull's hide, of variegated appearance, and covered with a net work of gold.

sa: ततो देवर्षिगन्धर्वा विस्मयं परमं गताः। कौतूहलपराः सर्वे पितामहमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Then the celestials, the sages, and the Gandharvas were all filled with great wonder; and urged by curiosity they then thus spoke to the Grandsire Brahma.

sa: तेनास्मि कृतसंवादः प्रसन्नेन सुरर्षभाः। जगतोऽनुग्रहार्थाय याचितो मे जगत्पतिः॥
en: I was holding conversation even with his ever-contented self; that Lord of the universe has been entreated by me to show his grace on the earth.

sa: उभे सेने बृहत्यौ भीमरूपे तथैवोभे भारत दुर्विषो। तथैवोभे स्वर्गजयाय सृष्टे तथैवोभे सत्पुरुषोपजुष्टे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, both the armies were huge and fearful. None of the them could bear the other. Both of them were arrayed as if they would conquer the very heavens. Both of them consisted of excellent soldiers.

sa: बिभ्रतो हेममालास्तु चक्रवाकोदरा हयाः। कोसलाधिपतेः पुत्रं सुक्षत्रं वाजिनोऽवहन्॥
en: Decorated with golden garlands and having bellies of the hue of the Chakravaka, steeds bore the son of the ruler of the Kosalas, by name Sukshatra.

sa: ततो द्रुतं चैकशरेण पार्थ शितेन विद्ध्वा युधि कर्णपुत्रः॥
en: The great warrior Vrishasena, son of Karna injured the son of Kunti in battle-field with sharp blow from an arrow and began challenging with loud voice.

sa: मज्जत्सु चक्रेषु रथान् सत्त्वमास्थाय वाजिनः। कथंचिदवहश्रान्ता वेपमानाः शरार्दिताः॥
en: The wheels of cars being thus entangled, the steeds, yoked thereto, with great effort dragged them although they were tired and trembling and afflicted with arrows.

sa: किमाश्चर्यं कृतप्रज्ञः पुरुषोऽपि सुदारुणः। सुमहत् प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यं बलाकोऽन्धवधादिव॥
en: What wonder is there then that a wise man by doing something awfully cruel may even acquire virtue, as Balaka did by killing a blind beast.

sa: तस्य पारावतानश्वान् रथशक्त्या पराभिनत्। सर्वानेकैकशो द्रोणो रक्तानश्वान् विवर्जयन्॥
en: Thereafter the puissant Drona inflamed with rage, slew one after another the blue-hued steeds of his adversary and then destroyed his car, with a powerful shaft.

sa: सात्यकिस्तुततःक्रुद्धो धनुस्त्यक्त्वा महारथः। गदां जग्राह महती भारद्वाजाय चाक्षिपत्॥
en: Thereat that mighty car-warrior Satyaki highly excited with rage, laid aside his bow and taking up a mighty mace, hurled it at the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: त्वरयन्तः पितृनन्ये भ्रातृनन्येऽथ मातुलान्। पुत्रानन्ये वयस्यांश्च प्राद्रवन् कुरवस्तदा॥
en: son Sonne urging on their sires, others their brothers and others their uncles and others their sons and other companions, the Kurus fled away in haste.

sa: भीमोऽपि तं शरवातैश्छादयित्वा महारथम्॥ पश्यतां कौरवेयाणां विननद महाबलः।
en: Then covering the mighty car-warrior Karna with a shower of arrows in return before the very eyes of the Kauravas, Bhima sent up a loud war-cry.

sa: अथाभिसृत्य प्रतिवार्य तानरीन् धनंजयस्याभिमुखं महारथाः॥ विदारयन्तो व्यनदन् सुभैरवम्।
en: Then the great car-warriors Shikhandin, Satyaki and the twin brothers, with fearful roars advanced towards Dhananjaya and obstructed the hostile troops, striking them with sharp shafts.

sa: किरीटी भीमसेनश्च वृद्धक्षत्रश्च पौरवः। युवराजश्च चेदीनां मालवश्च सुदर्शनः॥
en: Those warriors were the diadem decked Arjuna, Bhimasena, Vrihat Kshatra of Puru's race, the youthful prince of the Chedis and Sudarsana the ruler of the Malavas.

sa: स्कन्धदेशस्थितैर्बाणैः शिखण्डी तु व्यराजत॥ शाखाप्रशाखाविपुलः सुमहान् पादपो यथा।
en: Shikhandin, indeed, shone most brightly with these shafts, sticking on his shoulders; even as a large tree looks very pretty with its numerous branches and twigs.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणां पुनराद्रवन्तमास्वाद्य रक्तं तमतिप्रहृष्टम्। ये भीमसेनं ददृशुस्तदानीं भयेन तेऽपि व्यथिता निपेतुः॥
en: O monarch, he, who then saw Bhimasena who was glad at heart by drinking the blood of his enemy and was placing the battle-field giving vent to those words, actually fell down to the earth out of sheer fear.

sa: स तैः परिवृतो राजा त्रस्तैः क्षुद्रमृगैरिव। अशक्नुवन्नवस्थातुमपायात् तनयस्तव॥
en: Surrounded by those panic-stricken troops of his, who then looked like puny animals, your son could not stay on the field and went away from it.

sa: सप्तभिस्तु शितैर्बाणैः पौरवं द्रौणिरादयत्। मालवं त्रिभिरेकेन पार्थं षड्भिर्वृकोदरम्॥
en: Then Drona's son afflicted the scion of the Puru race with seven sharp arrows, the Malava king with three, Partha with one and Vrikodara with six.

sa: विचेतसो हतोत्साहा: कश्मलाभिहतौजसः। आर्तस्वरेण महता पुत्रं ते पर्यवारयन्॥
en: They were distracted (with sorrow), their courage gone and themselves reduced in splendour under the burden of grief. Uttering piteous wails, they then surrounded your son.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासोऽसम्भ्रान्त इव संयुगे। भल्लेन शितधारेण चिच्छेदास्य पुनर्धनुः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced the mighty bowman (Drona) seemed a little flurried in that combat. But once more with a keen-edged bhalla he cut-off his opponent's bow.

sa: तावका रथिनस्तत्र दृष्ट्वा कृष्णधनंजयौ सम्भ्रमं परमं प्राप्तास्त्वरमाणा महारथाः॥
en: Warriors of your host then, beholding Krishna and Dhananjaya, were very much terrified. Soon however those mighty carwarriors recovered and put forth their activity and prowess.

sa: तत् सम्प्रदीप्तं बलमस्मदीयं निशम्य पार्थास्त्वरितास्तथैव। नचोदयंस्तेऽपि चक्रुः प्रदीपान्॥
en: Seeing our army (thus) lighted up, the sons of Pritha urging all their foot-soldiers through their entire army, acted in the same way (as we did).

sa: कलिङ्गानामनीकेन कालिङ्गस्य सुतो रणे। पूर्वं पितृवघात् क्रुद्धो भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Accompanied by the Kalinga forces the son of the king of Kalinga, excited with wrath for the destruction of his father by Bhimasena, rushed towards him.

sa: तांनास्यमानान् भीमेन दृष्ट्वा रक्षो महाबलम्। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत्॥
en: The mighty Rakshasa, then beholding the troops belonging to him fly away from fear of Bhima, rushed furiously upon the latter and covered him with arrows.

sa: सौवर्णं सत्यसंधस्य ध्वजमकिष्टकर्मणः। अपश्यन् युधि भीष्मस्य कथमाशंससे जयम्॥
en: How can you hope for success, since you do not longer seen the golden standard of Bhishma endued with untiring energy and (ever) firm in truth.

sa: सात्यकिवृर्षसेनस्य सूतं हत्वा त्रिभिः शरैः॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन जघानाश्वांश्च सप्तभिः। ध्वजमेकेषुणोन्मथ्य त्रिभिस्तं हृद्यताडयत्॥
en: Having killed Vrishasena's driver with three arrows Satyaki sundered his bow with a Bhalla and killed his horses with seven arrows. Then crushing down his standard with another arrow he struck Vrishasena himself on the breast with three arrows.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समार्पयत्। त्वरमाणस्त्वरकाले पुनश्च दशभिः शरैः॥
en: (He) then pierced him with twenty five darts and at that time when speed was (urgently) necessary, he again speedily pierced him with ten (more) arrows.

sa: तस्येषुधाराः शतशः प्रादुरासञ्छरासनात्। अग्रे पुढेषु संसक्ता यथा भ्रमरपङ्क्तयः॥
en: Hundreds of arrows most fearfully issued from his bow, one closely following the wings of another like the lines of bees (flying away from the hive).

sa: तमापतन्तं संक्रुद्धं दीप्तास्यं दीप्तमूर्धजम्। प्रहसन् पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रतिजग्राह सूतजः॥
en: Then that foremost of men that son of Suta smilingly received Ghatotkacha of blazing countenance and burning locks, as the latter was furiously falling upon him.

sa: मेघजालनिमं सैन्यं तव पुत्रस्य मारिष। प्रत्यगृह्णाच्छिने: पौत्रः शरैराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: O sire, the grandson of Sini received the assault of your son's divisions resembling thick masses of clouds, with his shafts resembling snakes of virulent poison.

sa: ततो द्रोणस्य यन्तारं निपात्यैकेषुणा भुवि। अश्वान् व्यद्रावयद् बाणैर्हतसूतांस्ततस्ततः॥
en: He then felled Drona's driver by striking him with a single arrow; then with other arrows, he compelled his horses to run away from the field.

sa: सैनापत्ये तु राधेमभिषिच्य सुतस्तव। अमन्यत् तदाऽऽत्मानं कृतार्थं कालचोदितः॥
en: Having installed the son of Radha in the leadership (of the army), thereupon, your son, insisted upon by Death as it were, considered himself most successful.

sa: तेषां गत्वाहमानृण्यमद्य शक्त्या परंतप। तर्पयिष्यामि तानेव जलेन यमुनामनु॥
en: I will today repay the debts I owe them by exerting my utmost in the battle) and will then offer oblation of Jamuna water to them.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा समरे विवर्मा च महारथः। धनुरन्यन्महाराज जग्राहारिविदारणम्॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, deprived of his car and coat of mail and his bow cut-off, took up another very strong bow capable of piercing every foe.

sa: ते मिश्रा बह्वशोभन्त जवना वातरंहसः। पारावतसवर्णाश्च शोणाश्वा भरतर्षभ॥
en: Possessed of the fleetness of the wind, these steeds of the crimson and pegion colours, O foremost of the Bharatas, thus mingled together, appeared highly beautiful.

sa: सपार्थः पार्थिवान् सर्वान् भूमिस्थोऽपिरथस्थितान्। एको निवारयामास लोभः सर्वगुणानिव॥
en: As the greed suppresses all qualities, Arjuna resisted all kings seated on their chariots even when his feet were touching the ground and chariot was wrecked.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं सायकानां शतैस्त्रिभिः। आजघ्ने प्रहसन वीरः सर्वलोकमहारथम्॥
en: Thereupon that brave warrior (the son of Pandu) smilingly struck this one (Karna), the mightiest of all car-warriors, (Karma) whose bow severed with three hundred shafts.

sa: ये त्वेतत्प्रतियोत्स्यन्ति मनसापीह केचन। निहनिष्यति तान् सर्वान् रसातलगतानपि॥
en: Those who will even think of contending against this weapon will be slain by it, even if he takes shelter within the bowels of the earth."

sa: गदयाप्यनया गुा हेमविग्रहया रणे। कालवत् प्रहरिष्यामि द्रौणेरस्त्रं विशातयन्॥
en: Or armed with this heavy mace adorned with gold I shall career on the field of battle like Death himself, quelling the weapons of Drona's son.

sa: श्वेताश्वौ पुरुषौ दिव्यावास्थितावरिमर्दनौ। शुशुभाते महात्मानौ चन्द्रदित्यौ यथा दिवि॥
en: Those scorchers of their enemies, the mighty warriors, with white steeds attached to their cars, looked like the sun and moon of the skies in brilliancy.

sa: स्वानुगा इव सीदन्ति रथचक्राणि मारिष॥ चरतस्तस्य संग्रामे तस्मॅिल्लोहितकर्दमे।
en: O sire, the car-wheels of that one, who was carcering in the battle, stopped, as if with terror, while they were moving in that bloody mire.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो भृशं कर्णः पाण्डवेन तरस्विना। रथकूबरमालम्ब्य न्यमीलयत लोचने॥
en: Thus deeply pierced by the son of Pandu endued with great agility, Karna held the Kuvara of his car for support and then shut his eyes.

sa: स पाण्डवबलं कर्णः प्रविश्य विसृजञ्छरान्। प्रभद्रकाणां प्रवरानहनत् सप्तसप्ततिम्॥
en: Entering into the midst of the Pandava army and discharging his arrows furnished with beautiful wings of that best of car-warriors (Karna) killed seventy-seven five Prabhadrakas.

sa: व्यवस्थिते बले तस्मिन्नने प्रतिहते तथा। दुर्योधनो महाराज द्रोणपुत्रमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: When the Pandava army was rallied and rearranged and when the Narayana weapon was thus counteracted, your son Duryodhana, O king, addressing Drona's son said these

sa: भयार्दिता प्रचुक्षोभ पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनी। वायुना क्षोभितावर्ता गङ्गेचोर्ध्वतरङ्गिणी॥
en: Your son's forces struck with panic became as much agitated as when the waves of Ganga (dashed into fury) by a tempest are agitated into whirlpools.

sa: ततस्तत्सर्वमाचख्यौ कुरूणां वैशसं महत्। परान् विजयतश्चापि धार्तराष्ट्रानं निमजतः॥
en: He then told (Drona) all about the great slaughter of the Kurus, the victory of the enemies and the great disaster of the followers of Dhritarashtra.

sa: आमिषार्थे महाराज गगने श्येनयोरिव। यद् यचकार द्रोणस्तु कुन्तीपुत्रजिगीषया॥
en: Like that, O mighty monarch, between two hawks in the heavens for a piece of meat. Whatever efforts Drona made for conquering the son of Kunti.

sa: ततस्तं विरथं कृत्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। सेनामस्यार्दयामास शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥
en: Thereafter depriving Kritavarman of the use of his chariot, Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, began to afflict his divisions with arrows of depressed knots.

sa: दुःशासनेन संयुक्तः कर्णेन परिवर्धितः। क्षत्तुर्वाक्यमनाहृत्य त्वयाभ्यस्तः पुनः पुनः॥
en: are ever Has been fostered by Dushasana together with Karna and had been repeatedly fanned by you who never paid regard to the words of Khattva.

sa: यदृच्छयैतत् सम्प्राप्तं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्। सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः कर्ण लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्॥
en: O Karna! This opportunity to fight has automatically come in hands like an opened gate of heaven. Only lucky Kshatriyas can see such opportunity to fight.

sa: समाश्वस्तस्तु वार्ष्णेयस्तव पुत्रं महारथम्। विव्याध दशभिस्तूर्णं सायकैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Then regaining his composure, he of the Vrishni race, pierced that mighty car-warrior viz., your son, with ten shafts furnished with wings of the Kanka feathers.

sa: ययातेर्देवयान्यां तु यदुर्येष्ठोऽभवत् सुतः। यदोरभूदन्ववाये देवमीढ इति स्मृतः॥
en: By his wife Deveyani Yayati had Yadu for his eldest son. In the dynasty of Yadu was born a son called by the name of Devamida.

sa: अथर्वाङ्गिरसावास्तां चक्ररक्षौ महात्मनः। ऋग्वेदः सामवेदश्च पुराणं च पुरःसराः॥
en: The protectors of the car-wheels of that high-souled personage were the Athurvan and Angiras; and Rigveda, Samaveda and Purana stood at the front of that car.

sa: हस्तानामुत्तमाङ्गानां कार्मुकाणां च भारत।
en: Human arms and heads and bows and torn umbrellas and chamaras, O Bharata.

sa: स एवमुक्तवा विनिमृज्य चापं लक्ष्यं हि कृत्वा वृषसेनमाजौ॥
en: O king! Gentle Arjuna wiped his bow with these words and started making fierce attack with arrows on Vrishasena, the son of Karna by targeting him.

sa: तमन्ये शूरसेनानां शूराः संख्ये न्यवारयन्। नियच्छन्तः शरव्रातैर्मतं द्विपमिवाङ्कुशैः॥
en: Thereafter the brave warriors viz., the Surasenas tried to resist Satyaki wounding him with arrowy showers, like a guide percing his mad elephant with the goad.

sa: ततो रजतपुड्वेन राजशीर्षं महात्मनः। मित्रदेवस्य चिच्छेद क्षुरप्रेण महारथः॥
en: Then, again, O monarch, that powerful carwarrior severed the head of the high-souled Mitrasena with a razor-headed arrow, that was furnished with the wings of silver.

sa: तथा विराटस्य पुरे समेतान् सर्वानस्मनेकरथेन जित्वा। जहार तद् गोधनमाजिमध्ये वस्त्राणि चादत्त महारथेभ्यः॥
en: Then in the chief city of King Virata he, all alone on a single chariot, discomfited all of us and forcibly took away the wealth of kine and the garments of all the great warriors before their very face.

sa: ते पिबन्त इवाकाशमश्वैरष्टौ महारथाः। व्यराजयन् दश दिशो वैयाघेहेमचन्द्रकैः॥
en: These eight great car-warriors, as if devouring up the skies, illumined the ten quarters, with their excellent chariots covered with tiger-skins and decked with golden moons.

sa: वसुदानश्च कदनं कुर्वाणोऽतीव संयुगे। भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्३८॥
en: Having made a great slaughter in battle, Vasudana was sent to the abode of Yama, by the son of Bharadvaja careering in battle with great prowess.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो दुर्योधनो द्रोणमभिगम्याब्रवीदिदम्। अमर्षवशमापन्नो जनयन् हर्षतेजसी॥
en: Sanjaya said Then king Duryodhana, under the influence of anger, approached Drona and addressing him said these word for inspiring him with delight and wrath simultaneously.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् यथावृत्तं संग्रामं कर्णभीमयोः। परस्परवधप्रेप्स्वोर्वनकुञ्जरयोरिव॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, how the battle between Karna and Bhima raged like that between two elephants desirous of slaughtering each other in the forest.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासौ नानालिङ्गैरमर्षणः। युयुधानेन वै द्रौणिः प्रहसन् वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: But this time, though thus deeply pierced by Yuyudhana with of diverse descriptions, that mighty bowmen, that son of Drona, worked up with rage, addressing his

sa: सूक्ष्मो धर्मो दुर्विदश्चापि पार्थ विशेषतोऽज्ञैः प्रोच्यमानं निबोध। हत्वाऽऽत्मानमात्मना प्राप्नुयास्त्वं वधाद् भ्रातुर्नरकं चातिघोरम्॥
en: O Partha, religion is very subtle and awfully unintelligible, the more so to the ignorant. Hear me tell you of it. Suicide is tantamount to fratricide and in either case condemnation to the same hell would have been inevitable.

sa: स तु रुक्मरथासक्तो दुःशासनशरार्दितः। अमर्षात् तव पुत्रस्य शरैर्वाहानवाकिरत्॥
en: on The latter, then mounted on a golden chariot and afflicted with rage and began to cover the animals of your son with his own arrows.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं राजा सूतपुत्रं कृताञ्जलिम्। सुदीर्घमथ निःश्वस्य दुःखात इदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sighing heavy and hot, the king, oppressed with grief, addressed in these words the son of Suta, who with folded hands, was telling him the above.

sa: योधानां प्रीतिजननं द्रौणेश्च भरतर्षभ॥ ततो रथसहस्रेण द्विरदानां शतैत्रिभिः।
en: And the son of Drona caused a great delight to the warriors, O best of the Bharatas. Then followed by one thousand cars, three hundred elephants.

sa: तां तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रो द्रोणेन निहतां शरैः। विमलं खङ्गमादत्त शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्॥
en: Beholding that mace of his cut-off by Drona by means of his arrows, that foremost of men, that prince of the Panchalas, quickly took up a clean sword and a resplendent shield with its ground decked with hundred moons.

sa: मनोरथप्रलापा मे न ग्राह्यास्तव सूतज॥ सदा क्षिपसि वै कृष्णौ धर्मराजं च पाण्डवम्।
en: Kripa said Your intentions being like the ravings (of a mad man) cannot be acceptable to me, inasmuch as you always tale to me, inasmuch as you always speak depreciatingly of Krishna, Arjuna and Dharmaraj, the son of Pandu.

sa: समुन्पतन्ति वल्मीकाद् यथाक्रुद्धा महोरगाः। तथा द्रोणरथाद् राजन्नापतन्ति तनुच्छिदः॥
en: Just as, O king, mighty snakes excited to fury, plunge off from the ant-hills, so from the car of Drona numerous shafts were seen to fly.

sa: सर्वलोकवहां रौद्रां परलोकवहां नदीम्। सस्थान् रथिनः सर्वान् पार्थचापच्युतैः शरैः॥ द्रौणेरपहतान् संख्ये ददृशुः स च तां तथा। प्रावर्तयन्महाघोरां नदी परवहां तदा॥
en: That dreadful blood river was flowing towards. The another world and swaying with its course all people there. All people present there saw all warriors holding chariots under lead of Ashvatthama beheaded with the arrows shot by Arjuna. Ashvatthama himself took notice of that scenario. He also had flown a river floating people to another world at that time under the sheer grip of anger.

sa: तेषामप्यस्यतां संख्ये सर्वेषां सव्यदक्षिणम्। मण्डलान्येव चापानि व्यदृश्यन्त जनाधिप॥
en: The bows of all those warriors also, O king, engaged in shooting shafts right and left, were also seen incessantly to be deawn in a circle.

sa: संशप्तकास्तु समरे शरवृष्टीः समन्ततः। अपातयन् पार्थमूर्ध्नि जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः॥
en: The Samsaptakas too, desirous of acquiring victory and worked up with rage, made a downpour of their arrows from all sides on the head of Partha.

sa: ते ललाटं विनिर्भिद्य सूतपुत्रस्य भारत। विविशुश्चोदितास्तेन वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Shot by him, O sire, those arrows penetrating through the forehead of Suta's son entered it, like so many snakes entering their holes in the ant-hills.

sa: तस्याचार्यस्य वृद्धस्य द्रोहो नित्योपकारिणः। कृतो ह्यनार्चरस्माभी राज्यार्थे लुब्धवुद्धिभिः॥
en: Even such a preceptor, venerable in years and devoted to our welfare, has been injured by ourselves, who have betaken to mean conduct for securing sovereignty.

sa: हेमपुङ्खा प्रसन्नाग्रा भीमसेनधनुश्च्युताः। प्राच्छादयंस्ते राधेयं शलभा इव पावकम्॥
en: Furnished with golden wings, keen points and discharged from the bow of Bhimasena, those arrows covered Radha's son like fights of insects covering a blazing fire.

sa: प्रतिमानेषु कुम्भेषु दन्तवेष्टेषु चापरे। निगृहीतां भृशं नागाः प्रासतोमरशक्तिभिः॥
en: Many other elephants were very severely struck in their cheeks, the frontal globs and the parts between their tusks with spears, lances and shafts, called Shakti.

sa: शल्य उवाच यन्मां ब्रवीषि गान्धारे मध्ये सैन्यस्य कौरव। विशिष्टं देवकीपुत्रात् प्रीतिमनम्यहं त्वहि॥
en: Shalya said O son of Gandhari, O descendant of the Kuru race, as you tell me that amongst all these troops there is none more accomplished than the son of Devaki, even so I am highly gratified with you.

sa: तदादाय गतो राजंस्त्वरमाणो महामृगः। आश्रमान्तरितः शीघ्रं प्लवमानो महाजवः॥
en: And O monarch, taking those (articles) away that great deer of exceeding fleetness, with great leaps very soon distanced itself (a great way) from the hermitage.

sa: अमर्षितो हि कृष्णोऽपि दृष्ट्वा पार्थांस्तथा गतान्। कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासंगानब्रवीच्च युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: And Krishna, beholding the sons of Pritha, gone to the woods and dressed in the skins of black deer, became greatly annoyed and addressing Yudhishthira, said,

sa: यास्यामि पदवीं भ्रातुः सात्वतस्य च धीमतः। सोऽद्य यत्तो रणे पार्थ परिरक्ष युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: I am proceeding in the track of my brother and that intelligent scion of the Satvata race, namely Satyaki. So today, do you protect king Yudhisthira the son of Pritha in battle, exerting to the best of your prowess.

sa: लोकस्य चैव सर्वस्य प्रिय आसीन्महायशाः। परिक्षीणेषु कुरुषु सोत्तरायामजीजनत्॥
en: He was the favourite of all men and was greatly renowned. He was born in the womb of Uttara when the Kuru race was almost destroyed.

sa: युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संक्षिप्य मधुसूदन। आत्मनैवात्मसात् कृत्वा जगदासीः परंतप॥
en: O slayer of Madhu. O chastiser of foes, contracting all things and withdrawing this universe into your own self, you stay at the end of Yuga.

sa: शिष्यवृत्तिक्रमेणैव विद्यामाप्नोति यः शुचिः। ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतस्यास्य प्रथमः पाद उच्यते॥
en: He who gains knowledge (of his duties) by observing the duties of other disciples is said to observe the first step of the vow of asceticism.

sa: वर्तमाने महाराज महे रैवतकस्य च। उपायात् पुण्डरीकाक्षो युयुधानानुपस्तदा॥
en: It was at the time, O king, when the festival of Raivataka had begun, that he having eyes like lotus-petals arrived with Satyaki as his companion.

sa: शिरसा चार्घ्यमादाय शुचिः प्रयतमानसः। नाम संकीर्तयामास तस्मिन् ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमे॥
en: Purifying himself and making his mind exceedingly attentive and also taking the Arghya on his head, he loudly uttered his name near that foremost of Rishis.

sa: भृशं विध्येच्छम एवेह कार्यः। संरोष्यमाणः प्रतिहष्यते यः स आदत्ते सुकृतं वै परस्य॥
en: If a person deeply cuts a wise man with wordy arrows, the wise man should remain silent. The man who, though sought to be angered, rejoices without giving way to anger, takes away from the provoker all his merits,

sa: तत्राल्पेनैव सिध्यन्ति मानवास्तपसा विभो। जम्बूभार्गो महाराज ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्॥ आश्रमः शाम्यतां श्रेष्ठ मृगद्विजनिषेवितः।
en: O lord, here men obtain success in their asceticism with less austerities. O great king, here also is Jambumarga, the herinitage of Rishis of subdued soul. O foremost of selfcontrolled men, the hermitage is frequented by birds and deer.

sa: क्षेपायमाणमभिषगव्यलीकं निगृह्णाति ज्वलितं यश्च मन्युम्। अदुष्टचेता मुदितोऽनसूयुः स आदत्ते सुकृतं वै परेषाम्॥
en: That man of virtuous soul, who, full of joy and shom of malice, control his burning ire which, if indulged, would lead him to speak ill of others and verily become his enemy, takes away the merits of others.

sa: सम्प्राप्य दिवमाकाशमादित्यस्यन्दने स्थितः। अत्यरोचश्च भूतात्मन् भास्करं स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: O soul of all creatures, covering the heaven and the sky, you dwell in the body of the sun and afflict him with your own effulgence.

sa: ये च बुद्धिसुखं प्राप्ता द्वन्द्वातीता विमत्सराः। तान् नैवार्था न चाना व्यथयन्ति कदाचन॥
en: Those who have succeeded in acquiring real happiness, and who have become freed from the pleasures and pains of this world, and who are shorn of envy, are never moved by either the accession of wealth or its loss.

sa: प्रियङ्ग्वाम्रणोपेता वानीरफलमालिनी। प्रत्यक्स्रोता नदी पुण्या नर्मदा तत्र भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, there flows in a westward course the sacred river Narmada, graced by Priyangu and adorned with mango trees and engar-landed by cranes.

sa: उपयान्तं दुराधर्षं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्। पुरुपं पुण्डरीकाक्षं किं वक्ष्यामि महाभुजम्॥
en: When that irresistible and mighty-armed hero, that holder of the conch, the discuss and the club, will return, what shall I say to that lotus-eyed one?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न वै निगुणमात्मानं मन्ये देवर्षिसत्तम। तथास्मि दुःखसंतप्तो यथा नान्यो महीपतिः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O foremost of celestials Rishis, I do not think that I am not endued with some merit. But I am still afflicted with so much sorrow that (I believe) there is no other king like me.

sa: तदेतद् राज्ञो महाभाग्यमप्युक्तवान् नारदः॥
en: It is thus that Narada has described the greatness of the royal order.

sa: स घोररूयो व्यचरत् कालवच्छिविरे ततः। अपश्यद् द्रौपदीपुत्रानवशिष्टांश्च सोमकन्॥
en: Of terrible form, he moved about in the camp like Yama himself, and at last saw the sons of Draupadi and the residue of the Somakas.

sa: अधर्मा धर्मरूपेण तृणैः कूपा इवावृताः। तेषां दमः पवित्राणि प्रलापा धर्मसंश्रिताः। सर्वं हि विद्यते तेषु शिष्टाचारः सुदुर्लभः॥
en: Sinful persons hide themselves under the guise of virtue, even as the wells remain undiscovered on account of the grasses growing over and covering them. The selfcontrol, which they seem to possess, their holiness, their speeches regarding virtue, all these are witnessed in them. But good behaviours are hardly found in them.

sa: तथा वर्तति संग्रामे गजवाजिनरक्षये॥ नराश्वनागदेहेभ्यः प्रसृता लोहितापगा। गजाश्वनरदेहान् सा व्युवाह पतितान् बहून्॥
en: As that battle, destructive of elephants, horses and men, raged on fiercely a river of blood flew from the bodies of men, horses and elephants. That stream carried away many bodies of men, horses and elephants that fell there.

sa: दिवोदास उवाच श्रुतमेतन्मया पूर्वं किमुक्त्वा विस्तरं द्विज। काक्षितो हि मयैषोऽर्थः श्रुत्वैव द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Divodasa said I have heard of all this already; what is the necessity of repeating all this in detail. As soon as I heard of this, O best among the twice-born, this object (children) was desired for by me.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं पञ्चालाः सहसोमकाः। पृष्ठतोऽनुययुः शूरा मघवन्तमिवामराः॥
en: Then as that mighty-armed one proceeded onwards, the Panchalas together with the Somakas, all endued with heroism, followed him from behind, like the celestials following Maghavat.

sa: अकालमृत्युर्विश्वासो विश्वसन् हि विपद्यते। यस्मिन् करोति विश्वासमिच्छतस्तस्य जीवति॥
en: Over-confidence is premature death. One incurs danger by over-confidence, If one trusts another completely, he is said to live by the favour of the trusted person.

sa: पश्यतो वृष्णिदाराश्च मम ब्रह्मन् सहस्रशः॥ आभीरैरनुसृत्याजौ हताः पञ्चनदालयैः।
en: In my very sight, O Brahmana, thousands of Vrishni ladies were carried away by the Abhiras of the country of the five waters, who attacked us.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा नियमेनाथ स्वाध्यायाम्नायकर्शितम्। भीष्मं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ मुनिः प्रीतमनाभवत्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of the Kuru race, Bhishma, rendered emaciated by the observance of vows and the study of the Vedas, the Rishi became exceedingly pleased.

sa: अक्षयं निळलीकं च दानमेतन्महाफलम्॥ अस्माकं परितोषश्च अक्षयः परिकीर्त्यते।
en: Such gifts never become vain. On the other hand they yield great and endless fruits. The gratification we derive from them is considered to be inexhaustible.

sa: वयं राज्यमनुप्राप्ताः पृथिवी च वशे स्थिता। तव प्रसादाद् भगवंस्त्रिलोकगतिविक्रम॥ जयं प्राप्ता यशश्चयं न च धर्मच्युता वयम्।
en: We have regained our kingdom and the whole Earth has come under our sway, O divine lord, through your favour, O refuge of the three worlds and, O you of three steps. Through your favour we have gained victory and obtained great fame and have not transgressed the duties of our order.'

sa: शरजालावृतं व्योम चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ। मेघाविव तपापाये वीरौ समरदुर्मदौ॥
en: Invincible in battle, those two heroic and great car-warrior covered the firmament with arrowy nets like the clouds (covering the sky) at the end of summer,

sa: अधनेनार्थकामेन नार्थः शक्यो विधित्सितुम्। अर्थरर्था निबध्यन्ते गजैरिव महागजाः॥
en: If a person who has no wealth desires to accomplish a particular object, he meets with failure. Wealth Wealth accumulates wealth, like elephants capturing (wild) elephants.

sa: स पितॄस्तर्पयामास देवांश्च परमद्युतिः। ऋषींश्च तर्पयामास विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: That greatly effulgent hero (Bhishma) gratified the Pitris, the celestials and the Rishis with offering oblations to them according to the rites ordained in the Shastras.

sa: तेषां समुपविष्टानां नकुलो दुःखितस्तदा। अब्रवीद् भ्रातरं श्रेष्ठममर्षात् कुरुनन्दनम्॥
en: When they were seated, Nakula with a heavy heart and through impatience addressed his (eldest) brother, the best of the sons of the Kuru race, (thus)

sa: अम्बरीषस्य मान्धातुः पृथिवी सा त्वयि स्थिता। स त्वां द्रव्यमयो यज्ञः सम्प्राप्तः सर्वदक्षिणः॥
en: You should, therefore, celebrate a great sacrifice with enough presents of all sorts and a sufficient quantity of the Earth's produce. If you do not perform that sacrifice, O king, then the sins of this kingdom will visit you.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज कर्णमाश्लिष्य भारत।॥ राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं चिन्तयामास कौरवः।
en: O great king, O descendant of Bharata, having said this, he embraced Karna. That Kuru prince then began to think of that foremost of sacrifices Rajasuya.

sa: एवमव्यग्रवर्णानां कपिलानां महौजसाम्। प्रदाने प्रथमः कल्पः सर्वासामेव कीर्तितः॥
en: Hence, O king, the gift of kine is considered as primarily desirable of Kapila kine which are endued with great energy and possessed of unchanged colour.

sa: यद्ययं प्रतियुद्ध्येत् त्वां स्वकर्म क्षत्रियस्य तत्। जिगीषमाणस्त्वां युद्धे पितृपैतामहे पदे॥ त्वं चापि प्रतियुद्ध्येथा विजिगीषुव्रते स्थितः। अयुध्वैव नियोगान्मे वशे कुरु हिते स्थितः॥
en: If he engages in battle with you, he will do what as a Kshatriya he should do. Indeed, if, following the conduct of his ancestors, he fights for conquering you, it will be your duty to fight him, for as a Kshatriya it is your duty to conquer antagonists. Without engaging in battle, however, do you, at my behest, employ him under you from desire of benefiting yourself.

sa: श्रीरुवाच प्रकीर्णं भाजनं यत्र भिन्नभाण्डमथासनम्। योषितश्चैव हन्यन्ते कश्मलोपहते गृहे॥ देवताः पितरश्चैव उत्सवे पर्वणीषु वा। निराशा:प्रतिगच्छन्ति कश्मलोपहताद् गृहात्॥
en: Shree said The celestials and departed Manes leave that sinful house, in which eating and drinking vessels and seats and beds lie scattered and in which women are beaten. Without accepting the offerings made to them by the owners of such houses, the celestials and the departed Manes fly away from such a sinful house.

sa: भूतभव्यभविष्याणां भावानां भुवि भावनाः। त्रिवर्गनिरता नित्यं धर्मोऽर्थः काम इत्यपि॥ कामवृत्ताः प्रमोदन्ते सर्वकामसमृद्धिभिः। अर्वाक्स्रोतस इत्येते मनुष्या रजसा वृताः॥
en: These men on Earth who meditate on the past, present, and the future, who are devoted to the threefold objects of life, viz., Religion, Profit, and Pleasure, who, acting from the impulse of desire, exult on acquiring riches in respect of every desire, are said to be covered by Darkness. These men have downward courses.

sa: व्यालैश्च वनदुर्गान्ते स्त्रिया च परमोग्रया। कूपाधस्ताच नागेन वीनाहे कुञ्जरेण च॥ वृक्षप्रपाताच भयं मूषिकेभ्यश्च पञ्चमम्। मधुलोभान्मधुकरैः षष्ठमाहुर्महद् भयम्॥
en: There was fear from the beasts of prey, from that dreadful woman on the outskirts of that forest, from that snake at the bottom of the well, from that elephant near its top, from the fall of the tree brought about by the rats, and lastly from those bees flying about for drinking the honey.

sa: अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च पुनः पुनरताडयत्। तस्यार्जुनः क्षुरप्राभ्यां सगदावुद्यतौ भुजौ॥ चिच्छेदेन्द्रध्वजाकारौ शिरश्चान्येन पत्रिणा। स पपात हतो राजन् वसुधामनुनादयन्।॥
en: The ruler of the Ambashthas began to strike Vasudeva's son and Arjuna, incessantly. Thereat Arjuna with a couple of razor-headed arrows cut-off his upraised arms weilding the pole of Indra; and then with another winged shaft be cut off his head. Then that king, O monarch, fell down on the earth creating a loud noise.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। वज्रकल्पां चतुष्किष्कुंगुवीं रुक्माङ्गदां गदाम्॥ प्राहिणोत् सूतपुत्राय षडस्रामविचारयन्। तया जघानाधिरथेः सदश्वान् साधुवाहिनः॥ गदया भारतः क्रुद्धो वज्रणेन्द्र इवासुरान्। ततो भीमो महाबाहुः क्षुराभ्यां भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima with his eyes red in rage, hurled, without thinking for a moment, at the son of Suta, a heavy sixsided mace adorned with gold, measuring full four cubit in length and looking like the bolt of heaven. With that mace, that enraged descendant of the Bharata race slew the welltrained and excellent steeds of Adhiratha's son, like Indra slaying the Asuras with his thunderbolt. Then O mighty monarch, with a couple of razor-headed arrows, the mighty-armed Bhima.

sa: मुनयश्च महाभागाः सिद्धाश्चैवोर्ध्वरेतसः॥ मरुतो वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवाः सवासवाः। यक्षा नागाः पिशाचाश्च लोकपाला हुताशनाः॥ वाताः सर्वे महाभूतास्तत्रैवासन् समागताः।
en: All the highly blessed ascetics, the Siddhas who have drawn in their vital seed, the Maruts, the Vasus, the Saddhyas, the Vishvedevas, Vasava himself, the Yakshas, the Nagas, the Pishachas, the Regents of the world, the several sacred Fires, the Winds, and all the great creatures lived on that mountain with minds concentrated in yoga.

sa: हिमवन्तं त्वया गुप्ता गमिष्यामः पितामह। बह्वाश्चर्यो हि देशः स श्रूयते द्विजसत्तम॥ तथा भगवता चित्रं कल्याणं बहुभाषितम्। देवर्षिणा नारदेन देवस्थानेन चैव ह॥
en: O the best of the twice-borms, we have heard that those (Himalayan) regions are full of wonders, therefore, O Brahmana saint and grandfather do you so ordain that under your protection we may safely reach the Himalaya, mountains, the performance of my sacrifice being entirely within your control, and then the worshipful celestial saint Narada and Devasthana have also addressed exquisite and well meaning words for our behoof.

sa: मातङ्गभुजवर्माणौ ज्याक्षेपकठिनत्वचौ। काञ्चनाङ्गदिनौ शेते निक्षिप्य विपुलौ भुजौ॥ व्यायम्य बहुधा नूनं सुखसुप्तः श्रमादिव। एवं विलपतीमा न हि मामभिभाषसे॥
en: Stretching your massive arms decorated with golden Angadas, resembling a couple of elephants trunks, and trunks, and coated with skin hardened by constant use of the bow, sleep, you, O lord, peacefully as if worn out with the fatigue of too much exercise. Alas, why do you not speak to me that am weeping so?

sa: नूनमाचरितं पापं मया पूर्वेषु जन्मसु। या पश्यामि हतान् पुत्रान् पौत्रान् भ्रातृ॑श्च माधव॥ एवमार्ता विलपती समाभाष्य जनार्दनम्। गान्धारी पुत्रशोकार्ता ददर्श निहतं सुतम्॥
en: O Keshava, is there a more sorrowful sight for me to see then that presented by those ladies of fair forms who are put into such a miserable plight? I must, forsooth, have perpetrated great sins in my previous existence, since I am beholding, O Keshava, my sons and grandsons and brothers all killed by foes.' While thus bewailing Gandhari saw the dead body of her son Duryodhana.

sa: परेषामुपसर्पाणां प्रतिषेधस्तथा भवेत्। आकाशात् तु वनाभ्याशं मन्यन्ते गुणवत्तरम्॥ बहुभिर्गुणजातैश्च ये युद्धकुशला जनाः। उपन्यासो भवेत् तत्र बलानां नातिदूरतः॥
en: While attacking enemies resistance may be offered from within it. In pitching the camp, a region lying near the forest is regarded as much better than one under the open sky by men who are masters of military science and warfare. The camp should be pitched for the troops not far from such a forest.

sa: राज्ञां वित्तं च कोशं च कोशसंचयनं जयः। अमात्यगुणवृत्तिश्च प्रकृतीनां च वर्धनम्॥ पाड्गुण्यगुणकल्पश्च सेनावृत्तिस्तथैव च। परिज्ञानं च दुष्टस्य लक्षणं च सतामपि॥ समहीनाधिकानां च यथावल्लक्षणं च यत्। मध्यमस्य च तुष्ट्यर्थं यथा स्थेयं विवर्धता॥ क्षीणग्रहणवृत्तिश्च यथाधर्मं प्रकीर्तितम्। लघुना देशरूपेण ग्रन्थयोगेन भारत॥
en: You have described also the duties of kings, and discoursed on their treasures, the means of filling them, and on the subject of conquest and victory. You have also described the characteristics of ministers, the measures that secure the prosperity of the subjects, the characteristics of the six limbs of a kingdom, the qualities of armies, the means of marking out the wicked, and the marks of the good, the attributes of those that are equal, those that are inferior, and those that are superior, the conduct which a king seeking selfaggrandisement should follow towards the masses, and the manner in which the weak should be protected and cherished. You have described all these subjects, O Bharata, delivering instructions sanctioned by the scriptures.

sa: सर्वे सुबलसंपन्नाः सर्वे विस्तीर्णकीर्तयः। सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते स्म निर्जिताः॥ देवैरपि सगन्धर्वैः सकिंनरमहोरगैः। सर्वेऽस्त्रविदुषो वीराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।। सर्वे प्रवरविज्ञानाः सर्वे लब्धवरास्तथा॥
en: All of them were endowed with superior strength, and all had achieved wide celebrity. They had never been heard of as having been beaten in fight even by the gods along with the Gandharvas, the mighty serpents accompanied by the Kinnaras. And all were skilled in weapons and heroic; and all were versed in werfare. And all were possessed of the higher knowledge; and all had obtained boons.

sa: आश्रमं तत्तयोः शून्यं प्रविश्य नरसिंहयोः। गोचरं गतयोर्धात्रोरपनीता त्वयाऽधम॥ नहि गन्धमुपाघ्राय रामलक्ष्मणयोस्त्वया। शक्यं संदर्शने स्थातुं शुना शार्दूलयोरिव ॥
en: O Rākṣasa, those two lions among men going out to enquire about the illusive deer, I was ravished by you, entering the empty hermitage O vile wight. And like to a dog incapable of standing before a tiger, it would have been impossible for you, to wait there in the presence of Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: आसुरेण समाविष्टः सोऽस्त्रेण रघुपुङ्गवः। ससर्जास्त्रं महोत्साहं पावकं पावकोपमः।४६।। अग्निदीप्तमुखान्बाणांस्तत्र सूर्यमुखानपि। चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रवक्रांश्च धूमकेतुमुखानपि।। ग्रहनक्षत्रवर्णाश्च महोल्कामुखसंस्थितान्॥ विद्युज्जिह्वोपमांश्चापि ससर्ज विविधाञ्छरान्।
